page.layout: One title page, all lines centred in one block, with a printer's ornament between the "Bremensis" and "BREMÆ" lines. No running head, page number or signature. Handwriting and show-through from the other side are in the margins and are not transcribed.

main_text.l: S.S. Theol. Licent. & P. P. Illustr. Bremensium

l.i: Ad diem XIV. Septembris horis & loco solitis.

main_text.l: Typis Hermanni Braueri, ibidem illustris Gymnasii

page.notes: Printer's ornament between "Bremensis," and "BREMÆ," not transcribed. Handwritten marks ("42" top right, "C 42" in the right margin, "X" at the top, a short stroke at the top right edge) are not printed and are left out. Faint "DISPU" at lower left looks like a label or handwriting and is left out. Show-through text from the reverse side is left out. A brown stain lies at the left, over the text area, without obscuring any letters.
